title: Museum of Broadcast Communications

services.name: Admission
services.desc: This online exhibit looks back at the past 50 years of SNL, highlighting it’s origins, Chicago cast members, and more. The Great Debates features curriculum modules that take a look at the influence on broadcast on media. This website also includes curriculum providing students with a context for understanding the dynamics of presidential debates. The Museum of Broadcast Communications’ Radio Hall of Fame honors those who have contributed to the development of the radio medium throughout its history in the United States. The Museum of Broadcast Communications is a registered 501(c)(3) non-profit entity. EIN:

blurb: The Museum of Broadcast Communications preserves over a century of media history, while educating and engaging the next generation of entertainers, journalists, and content creators. Experience the lights and magic of television and radio production by visiting the Museum.
